reasoning_content:
The issue is bundler 2.3.26 with ruby 3.1.4 and mutex_m default gem. `bundle install` puts mutex_m in vendor/bundle, but the system default gem 0.1.1 is activated by spring. Let me check if bundle has mutex_m installed.

This is a known issue: using `DISABLE_SPRING=1` works. The guide says `bin/rspec`. Let me try just `bin/rspec` without DISABLE_SPRING.

action.command:
cd /workspace; source /usr/local/rvm/scripts/rvm
ls vendor/bundle/ruby/3.1.0/gems/ | grep mutex
echo "=== try bin/rspec directly (spring) ==="
timeout 300 bin/rspec spec/models/setting_spec.rb 2>&1 | tail -8; echo "EXIT:$?"

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments:
{"command": "cd /workspace; source /usr/local/rvm/scripts/rvm
ls vendor/bundle/ruby/3.1.0/gems/ | grep mutex
echo "=== try bin/rspec directly (spring) ==="
